notes: No department- or college-level computing AI policy found. The closest finding is a pair of linked courses (CSC 216 lecture and 217 lab) sharing one all-sections syllabus with a detailed AI policy; the brief counts this as course-level, not unit-wide, so it is a course example. The CSC 217 syllabus states it was adapted from the university Provost's student AI-ethics guide and from CSC 113 and CSC 316 syllabi, which suggests the department's courses use a common template, but no page stating a department-wide template or rule was found. First collection (ncsu-ai-for-students, ncsu-delta-course-ai-guidelines, ncsu-grad-handbook-ai) holds only university-layer documents, so nothing is duplicated.
